title: Design: Empty Inactive tab keeps the column headings
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure no term is deactivated.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p4-03-a-new-shop-inactive-tab-empty.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The count pill reads 0.
  • The column headings Name, Due, Customers and Vendors stay, and one centred grey row under them reads "No inactive terms", with a line under it (as in ct-p4-03-a-new-shop-inactive-tab-empty.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Held: the design's version; D-10 and S1-23 follow the PRD ("in place of the table"). Released or deleted when question 9 is answered (register CT-D02).

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)
